rationale: A two fragment Gibson assembly: 150 bp of the CBh promoter record and 180 bp of the CMV promoter record. The designer composes 20 bp terminal homology arms, both junctions are distinct, both overlaps melt above the 48 C floor, every primer sits inside the Tm, GC, length and structure windows, and both amplicons are inside the PCR size window. Fifteen checks apply and all fifteen pass. Every sequence in this case is a plus strand slice of a real GenBank record already in this repository, at the offset the fragment source field records. The offsets are chosen, the bases are not. hairpin_engine is pinned to window explicitly, which is the documented sliding window stem score. The pin is explicit rather than auto so the verdict cannot depend on which optional packages a given environment happens to have, which is what determinism requires of a gold case. Note that ViennaRNA became a declared dependency alongside validator assembly-1.1.0, so auto would now resolve to the free energy engine; this case deliberately exercises the fallback instead.

rationale: A clean two fragment Gibson pair, 180 bp of the CBh record at offset 532 and 180 bp of the CMV record at offset 462, taken from WP-04's own fixtures. Every junction, overlap, specificity and size check passes and no check warns. This case is deliberately pinned to the window hairpin engine rather than to ViennaRNA, and that is the point of keeping it: it is the regression case for the recalibrated sliding window fallback. Before the recalibration this same design drew a primer.hairpin warning, and it was graded Tier B with a justification that said in terms that a 4 bp stem closing a short loop occurs by chance in almost any oligo of Gibson primer length. That justification was a true description of a defect rather than of intentional biology, so the case was documenting a false positive as though it were expected behaviour. The stem thresholds were recalibrated from 4 and 5 to 6 and 7, measured to take the warning rate on random 47 nt oligos from 0.899 to about 0.09, and the four primers in this design were measured at a worst stem of 4 bp with folding energies of 0.00, -0.50, -1.40 and 0.00 kcal/mol, all inside the -2.0 warning level. They carry no significant hairpin, so a clean Tier A verdict is the honest grade and a warning here would now be the bug. Section 3.4 is the reason this matters: a check that warns on nearly every correct design teaches the user to ignore it, and the case that enshrined that warning had to move with the fix.
